description: Low-level alternative to invoices: quotes a payment of an exact amount in one coin and how much USDT you will be credited. Returns credit_lock_id for create_payment (valid until expires_at). Most agents should use create_invoice instead.

amount.description: Amount the payer sends, in coin units.

amount_atomic.description: Amount in the smallest units of the asset (alternative to amount). Give exactly one of amount and amount_atomic.

asset_id.description: Coin the payer sends. Public asset code from list_assets (its asset_id field), e.g. "usdt" (USDT TRC20), "btc", "eth", "xmr", "usdc_eth".

idempotency_key.description: Optional. The same key returns the same result instead of a duplicate (safe retries); generated when omitted.

name: preview_payment
title: Quote a direct payment
